definition: An aviation software assurance standard that defines objectives for developing and verifying airborne software.
entry_text: An aviation software assurance standard that defines objectives for developing and verifying airborne software.
example: An avionics supplier traces safety-related requirements to their software verification evidence.
label: DO-178C

sources.note: Sections 4 and 6 explain DO-178C lifecycle objectives, activities and evidence for airborne software. FAA treats it as an acceptable means, not itself a regulation.
